issue: Interactive sh prompt is truncated or overwritten after terminal resize
cause: Bash running as sh counted Lake readiness and CWD frames as visible PS1 columns

reproduction.before: resize from 120 to 80 columns truncated the prompt
reproduction.after: complete prompt after resizing to 120, 80, 50 and 100 columns and Ctrl-L redraw

fix: Mark only the hidden prompt frames with Bash nonprinting delimiters; preserve other POSIX sh implementations
deployment: signed local CLI build; running production connections retained; published v0.3.6 packages unchanged
